reviewBrief.title: Add pagination helpers
reviewBrief.brief: Add pageCount and pageOf to src/pagination.ts so every item appears on exactly one page. pageCount(total, size) is the number of pages, and a partial last page counts.
reviewBrief.diff:
diff --git a/src/pagination.ts b/src/pagination.ts
--- a/src/pagination.ts
+++ b/src/pagination.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+export const pageCount = (total: number, size: number): number =>
+  Math.floor(total / size);
+
+export const pageOf = <T>(items: ReadonlyArray<T>, page: number, size: number): ReadonlyArray<T> =>
+  items.slice(page * size, (page + 1) * size);

pattern: captain passes a bare command as doneCheck
experience: Given a done-check inside a sentence, a captain must pass only the command. Prose after it becomes shell arguments, and a check like node -e ignores them and passes by accident.
rule: doneCheck: Only a shell command, run with sh -c in the crew worktree root. Done when it exits 0. No prose around it.
prompt: Implement subtract in math.js. It is done when `node -e "import('./math.js').then(m=>process.exit(m.subtract(5,2)===3?0:1))"` exits 0 when run from the project root.

source.note: Haiku 5.5 captain wrote the prompt's sentence into doneCheck; the check passed only because node -e ignores extra arguments.
